issues.description: The problem statement and tests expect a function named build_msd_circ(circ, distilled_state, y_states) but the template defines build_msd_circuit(...) (note the extra 'uit'). This name mismatch prevents students from implementing the function that the tests and problem text refer to and will cause import/test failures or confusion about which function to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the template function build_msd_circuit to build_msd_circ with the exact signature (circ, distilled_state, y_states) so it matches the problem statement and tests, or add a shim function build_msd_circ that calls build_msd_circuit to preserve compatibility. Ensure docstrings/signatures match the specification in problem_statement.md.

issues.description: The problem statement and solution expect a function named build_msd_circ(...), but the template repository defines the function as build_msd_circuit(...). This inconsistent identifier for the same conceptual routine (constructing the distillation circuit) will confuse students and break automated tests or references that call build_msd_circ.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the template function build_msd_circuit(...) to build_msd_circ(...) so its name matches the problem statement and the solution (or alternatively update the problem statement and solution to use build_msd_circuit). Ensure the function signature and documented behavior remain the same.
